name: Tachibana Yuuji
source:
Yuuji's parents had to leave suddenly for Hawaii on a business transfer so it was arranged by [url=https://vndb.org/c56152]Yuuji's father[/url] that he should move to Hokkaido to live with his uncle [url=https://vndb.org/c22207]Takeaki[/url] and cousin [url=https://vndb.org/c189]Saki[/url]. For Yuuji, who led an urban lifestyle in Tokyo for so long, the new kind of life in the wintry countryside of Hokkaido might prove to be difficult. What awaits Yuuji at his new residence are sleepless mornings, new friendships, new love interests, and lots of snow shoveling.

[spoiler]He is the direct descendent of the woman who planted the snow sakura tree.[/spoiler]
translation:
雄二的父母因工作调动突然前往夏威夷，于是他的父亲安排他搬到北海道，与叔叔[url=https://vndb.org/c22207]武明[/url]和表姐[url=https://vndb.org/c189]咲[/url]一起生活。对长期在东京过城市生活的雄二而言，北海道多雪乡村的新生活或许很难适应。在新住处等待他的，是无法安睡的清晨、新的友情、新的恋爱对象，以及大量铲雪工作。

[spoiler]他是种下雪樱树的女性的直系后代。[/spoiler]
